proposals.spec_says: For locally-pinned memory, full CUDA unregistration is performed.
proposals.code_does: unpin_memory removes internal tracking only; never calls cudaHostUnregister (src/lib.rs:249-267). No locally-pinned host-registration path exists.
proposals.resolution: Reword FR-005: unpin_memory is tracking-removal-only in all cases; full host un/registration is FR-015/FR-016 only.

proposals.spec_says: IPC handle referencing non-contiguous / unpinned memory is diagnosed and rejected.
proposals.code_does: check_memory_attributes (src/memory.rs:26) is a device-type check via cudaPointerGetAttributes (FR-004); does not separately diagnose contiguity vs pin status.
proposals.resolution: Soften scenario 2 to a device-type-only check.

proposals.code_does: create_spdk_dma_buffer_from_cuda_malloc / spdk_unregister_and_cuda_free / get_phys_addr / GPU_PAGE_SHIFT are intentionally pub, not IGpuServices methods.
proposals.resolution: Add an 'Auxiliary Public Helpers (backfilled)' subsection before Key Entities documenting them as intentional pub helpers.

options: Soften FR-008 wording (backfill): add an explicit p2p carve-out
Move the constructors onto IGpuServices (breaks spec 002)
proposals.resolution: FR-008 relaxed with a documented carve-out for the p2p/GDRCopy dma-module builders and get_phys_addr.

proposals.code_does: interfaces::GpuIpcHandle defines verified/pinned fields + set_*/is_* accessors (igpu_services.rs:63-118) not read/written by this component.
options: Remove the unused API surface (align/code change)
proposals.resolution: Key Entities GpuIpcHandle note appended marking verified/pinned as reserved-for-future, deliberately retained.

proposals.note: register_host_memory treats SPDK EBUSY (-16) as success and skips rollback; not re-surfaced as drift this sweep. Remains an open align-task pending maintainer decision.
